scope: 179 units/type/build, same-lock isolated reproducible build, 171 native-browser groups including 31 explicit known-task rotation cases, actual public HTTP/data preservation and one actual GPU image/credential rotation. Does not accept full faults, phone or fleet capacity; new features await manual user testing.
observations: The first access run opened the previous static router before the new build finished. Injected quota failures also exposed an uncaught put/second-abort path; journal transaction handling was fixed before freezing source.
The old AntD popover-inner locator was corrected to the installed popover-container. No product text was changed for the locator.

Journal export intentionally excludes canvas documents. The test was corrected to restore artwork separately and retain the immutable original canvas seed; a mismatched legacy seed correctly failed closed.
A one-pixel fixture created an unusable tiny node; a 512px synthetic PNG fixture now exercises the actual canvas UI without changing product layout.
An owned background test page failed actionability stability; bringing that owned page to front made the unchanged storage behavior observable. User browser tabs were untouched.

Public response.body handles were invalid after navigation. The final harness buffers actual cloud response bytes using route.fetch, hashes them and fulfills the unchanged response/body; it does not substitute local build bytes.

Some existing suite case labels retain v3 as historical scenario names. The new access suite independently reads actual DB4 and proves native v1/v2/v3 preservation; the public persistent profile independently proves actual v3 to v4.

The final isolated build reuses the exact native clean-install lock proved by the bound original receipt. Installation was not rerun, scripts were not disabled, and canonical node_modules was not borrowed.
Actual image delivery took 1483 seconds (24m43s), including queue/loading/execution not separately measured. This single sample proves delivery, not latency or throughput acceptance.

Only two new dedicated logical validation Keys were created and one of those rotated. No existing user Key was changed; all five validation logical Keys are now disabled and six credentials return 401.
Static promotion preserved blob CSP and did not restart API, Worker or Edge. No service database migration or new product timeout/retry/concurrency/retention limit was introduced.
